tools.title: Chromatic
tools.summary: Visual, interaction and accessibility testing and publishing for Storybook.

servers.name: Chromatic MCP
servers.capabilities: Read builds, tests and review state; chromatic_mutate can accept or deny tests, quarantine tests and create projects.

tools.notes: On Team or Enterprise plans an owner adds the connector once, then each person connects. Chromatic also serves the Storybook MCP (docs tools only) for each published Storybook at <branch>--<appid>.chromatic.com/mcp.

tools.title: Lighthouse
tools.summary: Automated audits for performance, accessibility, SEO and best practices.

servers.name: Chrome DevTools MCP
servers.capabilities: Drives a live Chrome browser through DevTools and Puppeteer: navigation, input, console and network inspection, performance traces, Lighthouse audits.

tools.notes: Lighthouse has no standalone MCP server; Chrome DevTools MCP bundles it (lighthouse_audit tool for accessibility, SEO and best practices; performance goes through its trace tools).

tools.title: SonarQube
tools.summary: Code quality and code security analysis (SonarQube Server and SonarQube Cloud).

servers.name: SonarQube MCP Server
servers.capabilities: Inspect issues, hotspots, projects, source, quality gates, metrics and rules, run analysis, and update issues as permitted.
servers.access: Issues, quality gates, metrics and rules of the projects the token's user can see; write tools such as changing an issue's status, and some tools (webhooks, system) need the Administer permission.
servers.scopes: SonarQube Server needs a user token (project and global tokens do not work); SonarQube Cloud a token with SONARQUBE_ORG. The token carries its user's permissions.
servers.pin: The publisher documents version tags, such as sonarsource/sonarqube-mcp:1.19.0.2785, and tags that follow SonarQube Server releases.

read_only.how: SONARQUBE_READ_ONLY=true disables the write tools (default false).

tools.notes: SonarQube Cloud uses SONARQUBE_TOKEN and SONARQUBE_ORG (SONARQUBE_URL defaults to https://sonarcloud.io, https://sonarqube.us for the US region); SonarQube Server uses SONARQUBE_TOKEN (user token) and SONARQUBE_URL, your server's address, set in each person's environment. SONARQUBE_TOOLSETS limits the tools. Licence is the Sonar Source-Available License v1.0, not an SPDX id.
